newsitem.title: DENMARK: BG Bank says equity offer fully subscribed.
newsitem.headline: BG Bank says equity offer fully subscribed.

text.p: Denmark's third biggest bank BG Bank said on Wednesday its latest 3.412 million share international equity offering was fully subscribed.

It said the price was 226 Danish crowns per share, raising approximately 771 million crowns in new equity capital, and that an over-allotment option of 341,200 shares might be offered from BG Bank's own portfolio.
"We are very pleased with the success of this issue," BG Bank CEO Henrik Thufason said in a statement.
The offer in BG Bank, formed from a merger between Bikuben and the post office's Girobank, was announced on September 23.
Thufason said that the issue, at a nominal 100 crowns per share and with J.P. Morgan securities as lead manager, had been placed mainly with institutional investors in Britain and Europe.
"The strong demand for this issue demonstrated investor confidence in BG Bank's strategy as well as in the Nordic bank market overall," Thufason said.
